svg.title: TrueCred system architecture
svg.desc: Full system architecture showing three phases: enrollment, live telemetry, and trust engine. Three modalities feed into feature extraction, Gaussian profiling, Mahalanobis distance scoring, exponential smoothing trust decay, and finally a verdict with modality diagnostics.
